data.one_liner: A transparent image in Dart code, represented as a Uint8List.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single constant representing a transparent image as a Uint8List. It is commonly used as a placeholder inside widgets like FadeInImage before the actual image loads.
use_when: You need a lightweight placeholder for FadeInImage.memoryNetwork
You want to display a transparent image using Image.memory or MemoryImage
avoid_when: You need a fully-featured image loading, caching, or manipulation library
You already have a transparent asset or custom bytes available
strengths: Useful out of the box for FadeInImage placeholders
weaknesses: Extremely narrow scope limited to a single constant
